name: Krabi Airport

runway.v: one runway, 14/32, 3,000 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration 08:30–16:30 local, and on demand

slots.v: Level 2 airport under Thai slot rules; non-scheduled flights must obtain slots
slots.quote: Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

ppr.v: non-scheduled flights need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead
ppr.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance

notes: AIP times are UTC; local = UTC+7 (Thailand has no daylight saving). Read from the 12 Jun 2025 AIRAC because newer packages (incl. 14 May 2026) could not be opened from this session; re-check against the current AIRAC before publishing. Slot level list is in GEN 1.2 section 3.2.
